Form 2439: sd.f2439 ("Did a mutual fund or a real estate investment trust (REIT) send you ... a Form 2439 for 2025", asked under div.any, which covers anyone owning fund shares) is a limb of sd.other_forms, which refuses Schedule D (sd.route_each and lines 4, 6, 14 and others, forms/2025/sd.yaml). Schedule K-1: scope.k1 is a limb of scope.schedule1, refused at scope.ready. Within scope line 4 is Form 1099-DIV box 2d alone; box 2d is "the portion of the amount in box 2a" (f1099div p. 5), so the box 2a condition is the input's. Project stands.
